source_window.dataset: OS Open Zoomstack — GeoPackage schema / local_buildings
source_window.data_date: Selected schema window does not expose a package build date; OS documentation states OS Open Zoomstack publishes bi-annually in June and December.

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public Exeter building footprint Polygon geometry with explicit building type/use evidence bound to the same record. The selected Ordnance Survey OS Open Zoomstack GeoPackage schema defines local_buildings as Polygon geometry, but its record attributes are only id, uuid and geom; no explicit building type/use field is present in that footprint layer. The source window is schema/source-area evidence only, so it receives no parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
